name: marketingskills
description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
one_liner: A packet of marketing know-how (how to write landing page copy, run an A/B test, fix SEO) that you hand to an AI assistant so it acts like a competent marketing hire instead of generic advice.
buyer: A technical solo founder who has no marketer on staff and needs to write landing pages, emails, and ad copy without hiring an agency.
business_use_cases: A solo SaaS founder uses the copywriting and CRO skills to rewrite their pricing page and measurably lifts signups.
A small e-commerce brand uses the SEO and ads skills to plan a content calendar without paying for a marketing agency retainer.
A fractional CMO uses it as a checklist system to deliver consistent, higher-quality work across multiple small clients at once.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid 'done-with-AI' marketing sprints for small businesses: install the skills, run a CRO audit, deliver copy and a test plan.
Become a registered tool partner (as the repo's own partner program shows) and pay for placement in front of its install base of technical marketers.

steal_this: This weekend, run the cro and copywriting skills against three local small-business websites, produce a one-page 'here's what's costing you signups' report, and pitch it as a paid audit.
